text_en: When he returned to Capernaum after some days, it was reported that he was at home.
text_cn: 过了一些日子，耶稣又进了葛法翁，人听说他在家里，

text_en: So many gathered around that there was no longer room for them, not even in front of the door; and he was speaking the word to them.
text_cn: 就聚来了许多人，以致连门前也不能再容纳，他就对他们讲道。

text_en: Then some people came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
text_cn: 那时，有人带着一个瘫子到他这里来，由四个人抬着；

text_en: And when they could not bring him to Jesus because of the crowd, they removed the roof above him; and after having dug through it, they let down the mat on which the paralytic lay.
text_cn: 但因为人众多，不能送到他面前，就在耶稣所在之处，拆开了房顶；拆穿之后，把床缒（zhuì）下去，瘫子在上面躺着。

text_en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven. ”
text_cn: 耶稣一见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：“孩子！你的罪赦了。”

text_en: Now some of the scribes were sitting there, questioning in their hearts,
text_cn: 那时，有几个经师坐在那里，心里忖（cǔn）度说：

text_en: “Why does this fellow speak in this way? It is blasphemy! Who can forgive sins but God alone? ”
text_cn: “怎么这人这样说话呢？他说了亵渎的话；除了天主一个外，谁能赦罪呢？”

text_en: At once Jesus perceived in his spirit that they were discussing these questions among themselves; and he said to them, “Why do you raise such questions in your hearts?
text_cn: 耶稣凭自己的神力，即刻认透了他们私自这样忖（cǔn）度，遂向他们说：“你们心中为什么这样忖度呢？

text_en: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven, ’ or to say, ‘Stand up and take your mat and walk’?
text_cn: 什么比较容易呢？是对瘫子说：你的罪赦了；还是说：起来，拿你的床走？

text_en: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
text_cn: 但为叫你们知道：人子在地上有权柄赦罪──遂对瘫子说：

text_en: “I say to you, stand up, take your mat and go to your home. ”
text_cn: 我给你说：起来，拿你的床，回家去罢！”

text_en: And he stood up, and immediately took the mat and went out before all of them; so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this! ”
text_cn: 那人遂起来，立刻拿起床，当着众人的面走出去了，以致众人大为惊愕，遂光荣天主说：“我们从未见过这样的事！”

text_en: Jesus went out again beside the sea; the whole crowd gathered around him, and he taught them.
text_cn: 耶稣又出去，到了海边，群众都到他跟前，他便教训他们。

text_en: As he was walking along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth, and he said to him, “Follow me. ” And he got up and followed him.
text_cn: 当他前行时，看见阿耳斐的儿子肋未坐在税关上，便向他说：“你跟随我罢！”肋未就起来跟随了耶稣。

text_en: And as he sat at dinner in Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were also sitting with Jesus and his disciples—for there were many who followed him.
text_cn: 当耶稣在肋未家中坐席的时候，有许多税吏和罪人，也与耶稣和他的门徒一起坐席，因为已有许多人跟随了他。

text_en: When the scribes of the Pharisees saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors, they said to his disciples, “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners? ”
text_cn: 法利塞党的经师看见耶稣与罪人和税吏一起吃饭，就对他的门徒说：“怎么，他与罪人和税吏一起吃喝？”

text_en: When Jesus heard this, he said to them, “Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick; I have come to call not the righteous but sinners. ”
text_cn: 耶稣听了，就对他们说：“不是健康的人需要医生，而是有病的人；我不是来召义人，而是召罪人。”

text_en: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting; and people came and said to him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast? ”
text_cn: 当时，若翰的门徒和法利塞人正在禁食。有人来向耶稣说：“为什么若翰的门徒和法利塞人的门徒禁食，而你的门徒却不禁食呢？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “The wedding guests cannot fast while the bridegroom is with them, can they? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“伴郎岂能在新郎还与他们在一起的时候禁食？他们与新郎在一起的时候，决不能禁食。

text_en: The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast on that day.
text_cn: 但日子将要来到：当新郎从他们中被劫去时，在那一天，他们就要禁食了。

text_en: “No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old cloak; otherwise, the patch pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made.
text_cn: 没有人将未漂过的布补在旧衣服上的；不然，补上的那块新布要扯裂了旧的，破绽就更加坏了。

text_en: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost, and so are the skins; but one puts new wine into fresh wineskins. ”
text_cn: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮囊里的；不然，酒涨破了皮囊，酒和皮囊都丧失了；而是新酒应装在新皮囊里。”

text_en: One sabbath he was going through the grainfields; and as they made their way his disciples began to pluck heads of grain.
text_cn: 有一次，正当安息日，耶稣从麦田里路过，他的门徒在行路时掐食起麦穗来。

text_en: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the sabbath? ”
text_cn: 法利塞人向耶稣说：“你看！他们为什么做安息日不许做的事？”

text_en: And he said to them, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need of food?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们从未读过：达味在急迫中和同他一起的人，在饥饿时所作的事吗？

text_en: He entered the house of God, when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the bread of the Presence, which it is not lawful for any but the priests to eat, and he gave some to his companions. ”
text_cn: 当厄贝雅塔尔作大司祭时，达味怎样进了天主的殿，吃了除司祭外，谁也不许吃的供饼，并且还给了同他一起的人？”

text_en: Then he said to them, “The sabbath was made for humankind, and not humankind for the sabbath;
text_cn: 耶稣又对他们说：“安息日是为人立的，并不是人为了安息日；

text_en: so the Son of Man is lord even of the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。”
